description: This PHP script is part of the TestLink open source testing management system. It generates a web page listing test cases within a specific test plan that have not been run and have no tester assigned, including functions for building tables, initializing arguments, and setting up the GUI.

classes.name: tlExtTable
classes.description: Custom table rendering class used to display test case data in a formatted table.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: Template engine class used for rendering the web page.

classes.name: testplan
classes.description: Class managing test plan data and operations.

classes.name: tree
classes.description: Class for managing hierarchical test suite paths.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: Class for managing test project data.

classes.name: tlTestPlanMetrics
classes.description: Class for retrieving metrics related to test plans.

methods.name: buildTable
methods.description: Constructs a table object for displaying test case information with optional platform and priority columns.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and retrieves arguments for the page, including test plan and project IDs.

methods.name: featureLinks
methods.description: Generates HTML links for test case actions such as execution history and editing.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up the GUI object with page title, labels, and project info.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the user has rights to view test plan metrics.
